# Rock The Hock Land Clearing

> Owner-operated land clearing and forestry mulching contractor based in Logan, Ohio (Hocking County). Serves the Hocking Hills, Hocking County and southeast Ohio: Fairfield, Athens, Vinton, Perry and Pickaway counties. Free on-site estimates. Phone/text (614) 379-2170. Email info@rthllc.com. Website https://www.rthllc.com/

Legal name: RTH Group LLC. A Red Brick Ranch company.

## Services
- [Land clearing services](https://www.rthllc.com/land-clearing/): homesites, cabin pads, pasture reclamation, land clearing for construction, overgrown acreage
- [Forestry mulching](https://www.rthllc.com/forestry-mulching/): 72-inch Raytree high-flow drum mulcher on a Cat 289D3 track loader; no burn piles or hauling
- [Brush clearing](https://www.rthllc.com/brush-clearing/): overgrowth, fence lines, property lines, invasive brush (autumn olive, multiflora rose, honeysuckle)
- [Gravel driveways and grading](https://www.rthllc.com/gravel-driveways/): driveway cut-ins, gravel drives, power-rake seed bed prep
- [Septic tank installation](https://www.rthllc.com/septic-tank-installation/): new and replacement tanks to the county-approved design
- [Gravel delivery and hauling](https://www.rthllc.com/gravel-delivery-hauling/): own dump truck; gravel, topsoil, fill, debris haul-off, equipment hauling
- Equipment rental: Cat 289D3 track loader, forestry mulcher package, brush cutter, auger, power rake, post driver (see https://www.rthllc.com/#rentals)

## Areas served
- [Logan, OH](https://www.rthllc.com/logan-oh/) (home base)
- [Hocking Hills](https://www.rthllc.com/hocking-hills/): Laurelville, Rockbridge, South Bloomingville
- [Nelsonville, OH](https://www.rthllc.com/nelsonville-oh/)
- [Lancaster and Fairfield County](https://www.rthllc.com/lancaster-oh/)
- [Athens County](https://www.rthllc.com/athens-oh/)
- [McArthur and Vinton County](https://www.rthllc.com/mcarthur-oh/)

## How quotes work
Send photos and rough acreage through the website form, or call or text. Every job gets a terrain rating and a brush density rating. Written quotes list fuel surcharge and equipment delivery as separate line items. Ground too steep to work safely is left out of the measured area.
